sources.title: Nobel Prize in Physiology/Medicine 2023: A New Way of Looking at ...
sources.snippet: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2023 is awarded to Katalin Karikó and Drew Weissman who laid the basis for inventing mRNA vaccines. Their research made it possible to develop COVID-19-vaccines quickly.

answer:
The 2023 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine recognized the work of Katalin Karikó and Drew Weissman, who were awarded jointly [2][4][5]. The prize honored their discoveries concerning nucleoside base modifications that enabled the development of effective mRNA vaccines against COVID-19 [2][5].

Their breakthrough involved using modified RNA for therapeutic treatments, which allowed the rapid creation of life-saving mRNA vaccines by Pfizer-BioNTech and Moderna [4]. Unlike traditional vaccines using weakened or inactivated viruses, this mRNA-based approach was a new way of inducing an immune response [6]. The prize thus recognized the fundamental scientific discovery that made these effective COVID-19 vaccines possible [2][5].
